newsitem.title: USA: Dole holds slim lead over Clinton in Texas - poll.
newsitem.headline: Dole holds slim lead over Clinton in Texas - poll.

text.p: Republican nominee Bob Dole held a slim lead over President Clinton in Texas in a poll conducted when Dole made a campaign swing through the state last week, the Houston Chronicle reported Wednesday.
Dole led Clinton 47-40 percent in the latest poll of registered voters in Texas, with Reform Party candidate Ross Perot polling 6 percent while 7 percent were undecided, the newspaper said.
The Mason-Dixon Political/Media Research poll of 808 registered Texas voters was conducted Oct. 24-26 and had a 3.5 percentage point margin of error, the newspaper said.

Other statewide polls have put Dole in a dead heat with Clinton, who plans a campaign swing through Texas Friday and Saturday in a bid to become the first Democrat to carry the state since Jimmy Carter in 1976.
